title: Learned metabolite selection supports a thrombosis classification panel in coronary-heart-disease patients
summary: LASSO and random-forest selection identified a six-metabolite panel associated with Doppler-defined post-traumatic deep-vein thrombosis among patients with coronary heart disease. The source reports evaluation of the resulting classifier in a separate same-center clinical cohort. These are retrospective biomarker associations and diagnostic discrimination; the study does not establish that the metabolites cause thrombosis or that predicted drug candidates are effective.
ai_technology: LASSO regression and random-forest feature selection; logistic classification
organization: Xi’an Jiaotong University; Honghui Hospital; Federal University Dutsin-Ma

evidence.tested: The source describes 218 discovery participants, comprising 93 thrombosis-plus-coronary-disease cases and 125 coronary-disease controls, and a separate 86-person validation cohort with 39 cases and 47 controls. A 2000-tree RF and LASSO selected six overlapping metabolite features, used in logistic diagnostic models. The original Methods describe clinical Doppler reference assessment, model construction and evaluation in the separate cohort.
evidence.unknown: Both cohorts came from one hospital and underwent different analytical batches. Differential screening preceded internal train/test modeling; some preprocessing used dataset-wide information, so internal split results are not a wholly untouched pipeline evaluation. The paper describes different internal split ratios for feature-selection and final-model stages. Blood sampling and Doppler confirmation were not simultaneous in every patient, and causal pathway interpretation is not established. Metabolite/protein totals vary across source sections; those totals and simulated therapeutic candidates are not represented as verified findings.
evidence.ai_role: Learned sparse regression and RF feature ranking selected the six-metabolite subset from measured profiles, enabling construction and separate-cohort evaluation of the represented clinical classification panel.

source_review.scope: Read actual clinical recruitment/reference timing, discovery/validation groups, preprocessing/feature-selection/model Methods, six-feature intersection and diagnostic-model Results. Causal sphingolipid and drug-screen claims are excluded from the represented finding. Original canonical online March 28 distinguished from April issue. Exact original article front DOI/title and fresh PubMed primary relationship metadata checked.
